text:
Maya: hey team — gotta step out unexpectedly, kiddo sick. I9m oncall primary until 22:00 UTC but need someone to pick up primary for the next ~6h. can someone take a rapid swap?
Sven: i can flip to primary if i9m sure secondary is covered. where are you at with the embed pager and the latency blips?
Maya: quick status — we had a noisy embeddings host earlier, auto-fallback worked but customers saw ~250ms extra tail. no open incidents after automated retries, but PagerDuty still has a few low-priority alerts. i9ve got the active incident id in the runbook notes.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert: PD-INC-7234 low-volume embedding latency spikes. current status: acknowledged by Maya. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeds-latency
Leila: i can be secondary for the window but i9m on a 30m call starting in 10. i9ll be reachable on phone and slack, but prefer if someone is primary that can handle immediate pages.
Tara: if Sven is primary and Leila secondary, i9ll be the hotshadow standby. happy to escalate to me if the page is noisy.
Sven: sounds good. @Leila — you ok with that? i9ll take full primary handoff and run a quick sanity pass on the autoscaler groups + recent deploys.
Leila: yep ok. i9ll jump in if anything escalates. will set DND off for the next 2h.
Maya: thanks so much. quick handoff notes:
- current primary node pool: embeds-pool-prod-2
- recent deploy: model-quant-v2 on 21:12 UTC (no rollout flags)
- quick check commands:
```\n# tail logs for kv cache errors
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embeds-runtime --tail=200 | grep -i \"kv cache\"\n# check autoscaler
gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-instances embeds-pool-prod-2
```\n- escalation path: pager -> @SRE-oncall -> @oncall-lead (if >15min)
Sven: running the log grep now, give me a sec.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-INC-7234 acknowledged by Maya at 2026-03-15T21:12:05Z
Sven: logs look fine, a handful of transient timeout warnings ~21:05 UTC but no OOMs. autoscaler shows 3/4 healthy. i'll bump target to 4 and watch for noise.
Ops-Bot: oncall rotation updated: primary set to Sven, secondary set to Leila, shadow: Tara. change made by Sven via /rotate-handoff.
Leila: saw the ops-bot msg, added a short note in the runbook: "Leila covering secondary while Maya OOO, reachable via phone"
Tara: can someone paste the canary rollback snippet? want to keep it handy in case latency regresses.
Maya: paste from notes — rollback snippet below:
```\n# rollback canary
rdwctl deploy rollback --service=embeds-runtime --to-tag=model-quant-v1
# verify
rdwctl monitor --service=embeds-runtime --window=5m --metric=latency_p95
```\nSven: got it. i9m going to run the rollback dry-run in staging and set alert thresholds + a short watch on traces. leaving myself as primary in the rotation UI.
Leila: confirmed — i9ll watch pager and take ownership if it pagers to secondary. if anything spikes and i9m on the call, ping Tara.
Tara: ack. if you need me to take primary for a minute, i9m nearby.
Maya: thank you all. i9m heading out now, will leave phone for urgent pages but handing primary to Sven. please update the calendar if you9re swapping further. :heart:
Sven: acknowledged, taking primary. will post an end-handoff note when stable.
IncidentBot: PD-INC-7234 status update: monitoring under new autoscaler target; no customer escalations in last 10m.
Sven: end-handoff — things stable for now, keeping increased watch for 60m. if anyone swaps or needs longer coverage, DM and i9ll update rotation.
Maya: thanks again everyone, really appreciate it.
Leila: thanks — enjoy the rest of your evening Maya, take care.
Tara: thanks Maya :) - Tara
Ops-Bot: oncall calendar updated for the swap window (Sven primary 21:12-03:00 UTC).
